skill.summary: Generates beautiful side-by-side diff comparisons for code review

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of skylv-diff-viewer—a full-featured professional diff tool for code review.

- Generates side-by-side and unified diffs with LCS-based algorithm
- Supports syntax highlighting and word-level diffs
- Compares files or entire directories; supports binary file detection
- Exports standalone HTML reports with VS Code-style dark theme
- Includes basic git integration and large file streaming support
